scope: Broaden source comparison across open-source ACIS readers, OCCT distribution boundaries, current LibreDWG AcDs source, and native rendering state; refine existing implementation gates without making a local support claim.

method.kind: Primary project documentation, source, issue, and merged-fix review
method.evidenceRule: Mutable documentation and source can identify routes and test design but cannot establish current runtime behavior. Self-round-trip and marker presence are not independent geometry semantics.

evidence.observed: Official OCCT project materials list ACIS SAT/SAB exchange among commercial data-exchange extensions, distinct from the open-source core format set.
doesNotEstablish: that stock OCCT or a standard FreeCAD build reads ACIS
the availability or entitlement of any commercial component in the local environment
correct interpretation of the project's DWG AcDs section
evidence.planUse: Do not treat stock OCCT/FreeCAD as an ACIS oracle. If a commercial ACIS component is used, record product, build, platform, component entitlement, and exact route separately. Keep cadmpeg an optional open-source direct-SAB candidate pending pinned runtime and semantic checks.

evidence.topic: Current LibreDWG AcDs implementation versus issue 1411
evidence.observed: Issue 1411 reports loss on LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at commit prefix 8a1ae764. Current mutable source has an AcDs section reader and parses selected indexes/segments; `_data_` and `blob01` are explicitly warned as unhandled, and a later decoder scans the section for ACIS BinaryFile/terminator markers and pairs found payloads with queued 3DSOLID handles in sequence.
doesNotEstablish: that the issue report describes current master
full DataIndex-driven payload decoding or order-independent entity association
writer support or complete AcDs preservation
valid ACIS geometry or current runtime success
evidence.planUse: Keep the issue as a version-scoped loss report. Pin before runtime comparison. Separate section inventory, index semantics, marker-scan recovery, exact handle association, raw payload hashes, writer disposition, and independent shape results.

evidence.topic: ACadRust advertised profile versus visible AcDs tests
evidence.observed: The mutable project README advertises version 0.6.4 and ACIS/SAT/SAB/B-rep functionality. Its visible AcDs test helper fabricates a marker-bearing SAB payload and checks the same library's DWG writer/reader path.
doesNotEstablish: that fabricated marker bytes describe valid ACIS geometry
evidence.planUse: Retain ACadRust only as a candidate structural differential after pinning. Require independently authored analytic expectations and an independent geometry implementation for semantic checks.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp TrueView render-state issue root cause
evidence.observed: Issue 1074 initially attributed a TrueView Realistic/Conceptual crash to absent VisualStyle and Material objects. Merged PR 1077 reports a reproduced fix: the active VPORT AmbientColor default encoded as ByBlock and was changed to explicit Black; patched output switched render style without crashing.
doesNotEstablish: that libdxfrw output has the same defect
that all VisualStyle or Material graph data is unnecessary
support for all render modes or CAD applications
evidence.planUse: Avoid speculative object-emission requirements based on the issue's original diagnosis. Add active viewport/default-state checks and a supported non-wireframe transition to the existing composed native-render gate.

existingGateRefinements: Separate DWG section, AcDs index/segment, entity/owner association, exact SAB, ACIS topology, units/analytic measures, and native rendering outcomes.
Use an exact pinned direct-SAB executable and only the bounded extracted bytes for an optional independent geometry comparison.
Generate AcDs controls that assert specification-defined non-positional handle association and bounded rejection of invalid offsets, duplicate/overlap, truncation, and unresolved handles.
Treat marker scan/recovery as diagnostic only; it cannot satisfy exact payload association.
At the composed native gate, inspect active viewport defaults and perform one supported shaded/realistic transition in addition to checking geometry and importer diagnostics.
implementationReadiness.consumerCompatibility: Keep the existing LibreCAD and LibreCAD_3 2D compatibility checks unchanged.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No external DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB files added; use permitted existing repository material or locally authored source controls only.
